session_history.text: Records observed activity while RM is running and unlocked. Memory mode clears on restart; file mode saves credential-free metadata as JSON. Review before sharing.

credential_manager.text: Keeps the device key and account cookies in Windows Credential Manager so the store unlocks automatically. Clearing them can make the store unavailable.

multi_instance.text: Releases Roblox's singleton mutex so RM can run multiple RobloxPlayerBeta.exe processes. Interacts with Hyperion and may risk your account or a ban.

kill_background_roblox.text: Periodically closes RobloxPlayerBeta.exe processes started with --launch-to-tray, and before each launch. Normal game clients are not affected.

auto_arrange_windows.text: After a launch burst, arranges the new Roblox windows using the selected monitor, layout mode, and padding.

grid_layout.text: Choose automatic tiling, a fixed column or row count, an explicit column-by-row grid, one row, or one column.

rename_windows.text: Sets each Roblox window title to its account alias (or username). Titles show up in screenshots and streams; originals are restored when disabled or on exit.

launch_delay.text: Minimum pause between account launches, 0-300 seconds. Can help if Roblox rate-limits rapid launches from your IP.

privacy_mode.text: Runs the selected privacy cleanup before each launch. Refused while a Roblox client is running; doesn't guarantee full account isolation.

privacy_cookies.text: Temporarily moves RobloxCookies.dat out of %LOCALAPPDATA%\Roblox\LocalStorage before each launch, then deletes the backup after a successful launch. On by default.

privacy_local_storage.text: Temporarily moves the whole Roblox LocalStorage folder before launch, which may clear other session state. Restored automatically if launch fails.

privacy_full_profile.text: Temporarily moves Roblox user-state folders (LocalStorage, logs, Downloads, ClientSettings) before launch. Roblox must be closed; the backup is deleted after a successful launch.

privacy_on_exit.text: Repeats the selected cleanup when RM exits. Skipped while a Roblox client is running.

mac_rotation.text: Rotates the active adapter's MAC once before the first launch each session. Briefly disconnects, may need admin rights, and some networks block new addresses. Close Roblox first.

mac_preserve_oui.text: Keeps this adapter's manufacturer prefix (first three bytes) and randomizes only the device portion of the MAC.

mac_alternate_oui.text: When preserving your OUI is off, uses a well-known vendor prefix for the rotated address.

developer_options.text: Shows Inventories and Asset Manager in the navigation. Asset uploads create permanent public assets and are moderated under the uploading account.

log_targets.text: Choose which Rust crates log at the selected level; others show warnings and errors only. Applies after restart. RUST_LOG overrides this.

log_level.text: Sets tracing verbosity for this build. Debug and trace are noisy and can slow down troubleshooting.

roblox_player_path.text: Optional path to RobloxPlayerBeta.exe or its folder. If empty, RM searches %LOCALAPPDATA%\Roblox\Versions.

encryption_password.text: Switches the account store to password mode (Argon2id) and asks for it at startup. Forgetting it locks you out of the store. Changing it rewraps the data key.

confirm_kill_all.text: Ask for confirmation before terminating all running Roblox instances.

refresh_on_startup.text: Revalidate all accounts (online status, moderation, presence) right after the store unlocks at startup.

remember_selected_account.text: Reselect the previous account when RM reopens instead of the first one.

compact_actions.text: Use icon-only buttons for primary actions when screen width is limited.

show_update_notifications.text: Show a release link in the top bar when a new version is available.

verbose_launch_diagnostics.text: Adds detailed launch and process-attribution diagnostics to the log. Helpful for troubleshooting but noisy.

data_folder.text: Where RM stores encrypted accounts, config, presets, and cached metadata. Changing or clearing files here can break the app; keep backups.

privacy_clear_clipboard.text: Clears the Windows clipboard after each successful launch so join history doesn't linger.

custom_game_args.text: Extra arguments passed to RobloxPlayerBeta.exe on future launches. Quote values with spaces. Launch URI parameters and credentials are reserved; unsupported arguments may trigger Hyperion warnings.

roblox_fast_flags.text: Writes configured flags to the selected Roblox install before launch; Roblox honors only its allowlist. Removing a flag restores its original value on the next launch.

auto_launch_on_startup.text: Launches the configured account and Place ID once after RM starts and the store unlocks. Invalid targets stop with a notice. Applies on next restart.

discord_webhook.text: Route events to up to 16 named Discord destinations. URLs are stored in Windows Credential Manager. RM must be running to deliver.

discord_moderation.text: Alerts on new or changed account restrictions found during refreshes. Repeated checks of the same restriction don't re-alert.

hide_from_screen_capture.text: Excludes RM's main window from screen capture (Windows 10 2004+; older versions may show a blank window). Roblox and browser windows aren't covered.

discord_batch.text: Completed or stopped batches from Accounts, Presets and Private Servers. Reports launch requests; clients may still be connecting.

discord_expiry.text: Sent once when verification finds that a working saved login has expired. Network failures alone don't trigger it.

discord_launch_failure.text: A validated launch request failed before RM could complete it. Includes account and place IDs, never credentials or private links.

discord_client_exit.text: An exactly attributed Roblox client exited, including manual closes. Doesn't prove a crash; inferred or unmatched clients don't trigger it.

page_visibility.text: Choose which workspaces appear in navigation. Settings always stays available so you can re-enable pages.

discord_friend_received.text: Checks incoming friend requests in the background. The first check sets a baseline; later checks run about a minute apart.

discord_friend_sent.text: Roblox accepted a friend request sent from RM's Accounts page. Requests sent elsewhere can't be tracked.

discord_friend_added.text: A request was accepted in RM, or a complete background check found a new friend. The first check is silent and can't tell who accepted.

discord_friend_removed.text: Fires when a friend is removed in RM or a full background check finds one missing. It can't tell who removed them. Blocking sends User blocked instead.

discord_friend_declined.text: Roblox accepted a decline from RM's Friends page. Requests disappearing elsewhere don't trigger it.

discord_friend_blocked.text: Roblox accepted a block from RM's Friends or Accounts page. Includes account and target user IDs. Blocks made outside RM aren't detected.
